profile_text.body:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited describes itself as the world's dedicated semiconductor foundry since 1987. The company says it supports an ecosystem of global customers and partners with process technology and a portfolio of design enablement solutions, and it presents that work as a way to accelerate innovation in integrated circuit design and product applications. Its site also discusses how TSMC contributes to global IC innovation and to Taiwan's economy.

The company is a public company headquartered in Hsinchu, traded under the ticker TSM, and also listed under the alias Taiwan Semiconductor-SP ADR. Its SEC CIK is 0001046179. The material available does not name specific AI products, and no lawsuits or MCP servers are listed for it.
